guard: the foreground spawn hands an armed session the same launch the manager does, and refuses a connector that publishes no event plane
why: Both mutations below restore the exact state this suite was written against, so the suite's
value is not a matter of opinion: it either reddens on the shipped bug or it does not.
The bug was invisible to every suite that existed. The connector's own suite injects a workspace
root in each accepted case, which proves the connector's contract in ISOLATION and can say
nothing about whether a caller honours it, and the manager's grant suite drives the manager. A
contract asserted only against itself is how a caller goes missing, which is why this assertion
sits on the caller's side of the boundary and drives real argv through the binary's own dispatch.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports the CLI by relative source path (../src/index.js,
../src/command.js), so the bytes mutated are the bytes graded: no dist in the path and no build
in the command. It imports @cotal-ai/core and @cotal-ai/workspace by package name for the
registry and the mesh record, and no mutation below touches either.
NOT PROVED HERE, named rather than implied. The mesh is OPEN, so neither authenticated branch
runs and the event grant landing in allowPublish is not exercised on this path. That property is
proved for the manager by smoke:events-grant and is not proved for the CLI by anything.

mutations.name: F1 the foreground launch drops the workspace root again, which is the shipped bug
mutations.expectRed: an armed foreground launch carries the mesh's own root for the write-ahead log
mutations.cell: an armed foreground launch carries the mesh's own root for the write-ahead log
mutations.note: Not a contrived mutation: it is the code as it shipped, where cotal spawn --events failed at launch construction for every armed session while --detach worked.

mutations.name: F2 the foreground stops refusing a connector that publishes no event plane
mutations.expectRed: --events on a connector that publishes no event plane REFUSES, by name
mutations.cell: --events on a connector that publishes no event plane REFUSES, by name
mutations.note: The other half of the shipped state: the flag was accepted and silently did nothing, which is the failure mode the manager's refusal exists to prevent.
